decisions.reason: The instruction to remove two lines does not identify the book title or alter the constraint excluding the unintended newline marker.
Removing two lines from an unspecified section does not change the copyediting goal or either approved passage recorded by this Requirement.
The source does not identify back matter or author lines, and deleting two unspecified lines does not cancel the requirement to include back matter and author-biography content.
The manuscript-text deletion has no necessary effect on image distortion, cropping, or pixelation constraints.
The source does not identify a Mama's Hot Take section and does not change its italic or quotation-mark treatment.
Removing manuscript lines does not affect the source, permission, review, or suitability criteria for chapter illustrations.
The content deletion does not alter the deferred paragraph-spacing or page-density requirement.
The source does not identify Chapter 18 or change the required distinction between its subtitle and body text.
The instruction concerns manuscript lines and does not change the cover image, trim size, preferred visual, or unresolved cover choice.
Although manuscript deletion may eventually affect pagination mechanically, the source does not change the requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after fixing the book size.
